summary: Containerized AAP 2.6 has two tested topologies: Growth (all-in-one, small footprint) and Enterprise (redundant, scaled out).
questions: What topologies are supported for containerized AAP?
Can I install AAP all-in-one on one host?

answer_card.title: Containerized topologies
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Growth** (all-in-one): getting started, smaller footprint
- **Enterprise**: redundancy and more compute for large automation volumes

Details, ports and example inventories: *Tested deployment models*.
